text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — planning to change autoscaler policy for dedicated GPU pool 'video-inference' tonight 23:00 UTC. Lowering scale-up threshold 0.6 -> 0.5 and set min_replicas=2 to reduce cold starts. Need deploy owner + smoke + rollback readiness. Ping @Liam @Sara. Window 23:00–00:00 UTC. Will run canary first.

Liam: I can own the deploy. I've validated the change in staging and a canary slice earlier today.

Sara: I'll run the smoke tests and perf checks. What exact smoke steps? sample prompt + embedding + 50 request ramp?

Liam: Smoke checklist I'll follow: 1) apply to canary slice 2) run 100 requests at steady QPS 3) check p50/p95/p99 + error-rate + token cost 4) verify KV cache hit not regressed. Commands: ```kubectl apply -f deploy/autoscaler-video-inference.yaml -n dedicated``` and ```kubectl rollout status deploy/autoscaler-video -n dedicated -w```.

Maya: Rollback plan: previous policy exported to s3://infra-backups/autoscaler/backup-1819000000.json. If p99 latency >300ms or error-rate >1% in 15min, rollback to that file with `kubectl apply -f <backup>` and scale replicas back.

Julian: I'll stand up dashboard alerts and watch during the window. I'll set temporary alert for p99>280ms + spike detection. If triggered I'll call the rollback.

deploy-bot: Deploy job queued by Liam for 2026-03-17 23:00 UTC — id deploy-1819123456

Sara: Canary soak (2h) done — p99 210ms, errors 0.4%, cost delta +1.1%. All good to promote.

Liam: Starting canary -> prod promotion at 23:00. Will do slice-by-slice: eu-west-1a, us-west-2a, us-east-1a. 10min pause between slices.

Maya: Note: keep a fallback pool 'reserved-fallback' ready to scale if things spike. Ops: if we see queue growth >20% abort and failover to reserved-fallback.

Liam: Kicking off — starting eu-west-1a now :rocket:

deploy-bot: Deploy progress: eu-west-1a done ✅, us-west-2a in progress.

deploy-bot: Deploy completed across slices. No immediate regressions.

Sara: Smoke post-deploy: 2k requests run — p99 225ms, errors 0.6%. Looks stable.

Julian: Alerts stayed quiet. No rollback needed.

Maya: Great — thanks all. I'll create a short follow-up doc and metric snapshot. Schedule 24h follow-up. :tada:
